import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Connect to the SQLite database
conn = sqlite3.connect('workday_data.db')

# Query to compute total total_employees_ever across all rows in workday__organization_overview
query = """
SELECT SUM(total_employees_ever) as total_employees_ever_sum
FROM workday__organization_overview
WHERE total_employees_ever IS NOT NULL
"""

# Execute the query and fetch the result
result = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)
print("Total total_employees_ever across all rows:")
print(result)

# Close the connection
conn.close()

        # Import the CSV data into SQLite

        cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';")
